question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mihir __teased and joking__ with Aastha until she started laughing.
solution:
The correct answer is "**teased and joked.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of the present participle of the verb "joke" is incorrect.
 
• **The verbs "teased, started" indicate that the sentence is in past tense.**
